blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `computeActions` method. This belongs to the Promotion Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).

This method provides the actions to perform on a cart based on the specified promotions
and context.
